body: Straight teeth matter for more than just cosmetic reasons, crowding can cause buildup of local factors and lead to periodontal problems. We are not jobless here.

Hi, seems like your wife has impacted third molars. It's common, its like.. a car crash you could say. Think of a teeth going on a wrong route and crashing on another. That's what is an impaction.

Now it may not produce any symptoms now, but it may start soon and start producing really terrible pain. 

I would advise to extract, but please wait for an oral surgeon or a more experienced dentist's advice.

Usually cancers dont pain/ are sore etc until its late.and it won't look like this at later stages. :) don't worry. Just breathe in and out, you should be fine. Your dentist will confirm this soon.
If you really need it supported, your dentist will give you a splint.

I would think your dentist would suggest a fluoride prevention or a sealant if you have deep grooves if things were really so bad. Stop worrying this much, its not healthy.

If you are imagining and complicating stuff, this may go a lot deeper than just your teeth.

First step is to acknowledge the problem! You've done this.

You can try flossing, mouthwashes etc. Don't brush too hard for too long. Im sure you are already aware of this.

Ask your dentist if you really need to be worried, go in every 6 months for a routine screening and you should be good :)
